a.text: To be upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the build-to-8 plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead before the reserve ever reaches 8. Only one of us can reach 4 cells right now, so I plan to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If we both survive the round, I'll operate the generator with you every round after that, and once I'm full I'll do whatever helps you get to 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. Sorry, I know you planned to stick to the agreement. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round from now on so the generator can refill the reserve for you. I won't take anything more.
